{"prose": "A token bucket is two numbers: a **capacity** and a **refill rate**. Tokens accrue at the refill rate and stop accruing at capacity; each request spends one.

The capacity is the burst you tolerate, and the refill rate is the throughput you actually enforce. People reach for the refill rate when what bit them was the capacity.", "widget": {"type": "param-playground", "title": "Bucket state", "params": [{"id": "capacity", "label": "Capacity (tokens)", "kind": "range", "min": 1, "max": 100, "step": 1, "default": 10, "format": "d"}, {"id": "refill_per_s", "label": "Refill rate (tokens/s)", "kind": "range", "min": 0.5, "max": 20, "step": 0.5, "default": 2, "format": ".1f"}, {"id": "elapsed_s", "label": "Elapsed (s)", "kind": "range", "min": 0, "max": 30, "step": 0.5, "default": 5, "format": ".1f"}, {"id": "spent", "label": "Tokens spent", "kind": "range", "min": 0, "max": 100, "step": 1, "default": 0, "format": "d"}], "view": {"fn": "tb_view", "args": {"capacity": {"param": "capacity"}, "refill_per_s": {"param": "refill_per_s"}, "elapsed_s": {"param": "elapsed_s"}, "spent": {"param": "spent"}}}, "readouts": [{"label": "Tokens available", "fn": "tb_available", "format": ".2f", "args": {"capacity": {"param": "capacity"}, "refill_per_s": {"param": "refill_per_s"}, "elapsed_s": {"param": "elapsed_s"}, "spent": {"param": "spent"}}}]}, "functions": [{"name": "tb_available", "source": "def tb_available(capacity, refill_per_s, elapsed_s, spent):
    """Tokens in the bucket after elapsed_s of refilling, minus what was spent."""
    cap = float(capacity)
    refilled = min(cap, float(refill_per_s) * float(elapsed_s))
    return max(0.0, refilled - float(spent))"}, {"name": "tb_view", "source": "def tb_view(capacity, refill_per_s, elapsed_s, spent):
    cap = float(capacity)
    refilled = min(cap, float(refill_per_s) * float(elapsed_s))
    available = tb_available(capacity, refill_per_s, elapsed_s, spent)
    return {
        "kind": "bars",
        "labels": ["capacity", "refilled", "spent", "available"],
        "values": [cap, refilled, float(spent), available],
        "highlight": [3],
        "x_label": "quantity",
        "y_label": "tokens",
        "value_format": ".1f",
        "caption": (
            "After %.1fs at %.1f tokens/s the bucket has refilled to %.1f, capped by its "
            "capacity of %.1f. Spending %.1f leaves %.1f available."
            % (float(elapsed_s), float(refill_per_s), refilled, cap, float(spent), available)
        ),
    }"}]}
